model.name: Universal scenario link on every detail view
model.description: EVERY detail view (WebItem, File, Member, Room, Task, Requirement, UseCase, Class, Method, Impl, Test — all types) ALWAYS renders a clickable 📄 Scenario link to /md/scenario/index/<shard>/<uuid>.scenario.json. No detail view may lack it — the scenario unit is the source of truth.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (traceability): every detail view must always link to its scenario unit — the source of truth. No exceptions.

discoverySource.note: Pattern exists in some views (📄 Scenario); must be universal.

acceptanceCriteria.text: All detail component types render a 📄 Scenario link (WebItem/File/Member/Room/Task/Requirement/UseCase/Class/Method/Impl/Test).
The link points to /md/scenario/index/<shard>/<uuid>.scenario.json (the unit on disk).
